reason: Provides a SearXNG-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness, retrieving search results from a configured self-hosted metasearch instance and integrating it with the existing web search tool.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供连接已配置 SearXNG 实例的网页搜索提供商，并将搜索结果接入现有网页搜索工具。
summaries.en: Provides a SearXNG-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness and connects retrieved results to its existing web search tool.

capabilities: Sends web search queries to a configured SearXNG instance
Retrieves and normalizes search result metadata and snippets
Registers and selects a web search provider in DeepSeek Harness configuration
Allows optional custom HTTP request headers
